faq.start.a: Go to “Startup stage”. You always see one task there — you answer, save, and the next one opens by itself. You can come back later to a question you can't answer yet.
faq.leave.q: Do I lose anything if I leave halfway?
faq.leave.a: No. Each answer is saved separately, the moment you click “Save”. You can close the tab and come back in a week.
faq.invite.q: How do I invite someone to the team?
faq.invite.a: In the Team tab, the Founder or an Admin creates an invitation link. The person with the link doesn't need an account — after signing up they go straight to your team as a Member.
faq.edit.q: Who can change answers in stages?
faq.edit.a: The Founder and Admins. A Member sees everything but can only read. The role is changed by the Founder or an Admin in the team list — a job title (e.g. CTO) doesn't grant any permissions.
faq.privacy.q: Can strangers see answers from the stages?
faq.privacy.a: No. Only what you consciously put on your public profile leaves the team. The validation stage is visible on the team card only with the Founder's consent.
faq.delete.q: How do I delete my account or a startup?
faq.delete.a: You delete your account in Settings → Account. The Founder deletes a startup on the team's public profile page, in the “Advanced” section. Both require confirmation — nothing disappears with a single click.
